mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_people AS currentPeople, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount, is_emergency AS emergency FROM volunteer WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_people AS currentPeople, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount, is_emergency AS emergency FROM volunteer WHERE volunteer_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer ( user_id, title, description, location, image_path, start_time, end_time, max_participants, status, current_people, created_at, updated_at, view_count, is_emergency ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{imagePath}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxParticipants}, #{status}, #{currentPeople}, #{createdAt}, NOW(), 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, current_people AS currentPeople, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount, is_emergency AS emergency FROM volunteer WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId}
mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, current_people AS currentPeople, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount, is_emergency AS emergency FROM volunteer WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY view_count DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer SET current_people = current_people + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND current_people < max_participants
UPDATE volunteer SET current_people = current_people - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND current_people > 0
